_doc: The builders: one kind of man, twenty of them (docs/design.md). Creel calls a unit that gathers a 'worker'. speed 6 is about 0.6 tiles a second, a loaded man's march (Dominic, 2026-11-12: they moved "very fast and very small steps"; it was 12). range 6 and reload 360 (18 s, data/guns.json adds up to 5 s more each time): the swallow-tail flintlock. The looks are the twelve sample men in art/men/vox/samples, given out by turn; the names are placeholders (Proposal) until Dominic picks them.
